angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop lean (Hoop G) as a day-3 film flag, not a board input; one frozen 2026 test (Hoop G vs held-out pick + role forecast of career pressure rate, leave-one-class-out over 2023-25); year-standardized drill measures; baselines pick + role and a shrunk full no-tracking forecast
metric_name: Hoop G: speed^2 / turn radius at a lineman's hardest half-second of the Run-the-Hoop figure-eight, in g, z within Combine year
headline_number: +2.3 pressures per 450-rush season per sd of Hoop G beyond pick + role [95%: 0.7, 4.0], n=77, held-out classes. Selecting the best of six inside each training fold gives the same R2 gain (+0.06, shuffle p 0.017) but its bootstrap interval spans zero [-0.27, 0.17]. Rush level (1,315 random rushes, player random effect): corner turn x Hoop G +4.0 points pressure [0.5, 7.6], cluster-robust p 0.11; Hoop G -> per-rush lean 0.05 sd [-0.01, 0.11].
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round 25 cand 1 (8.5). DS: nested best-of-six selection repeated inside each leave-one-class-out training pair (R2 gain, bootstrap with selection rerun, shuffle p with selection rerun) replaces the post-hoc adjusted p as the accuracy claim; rush-level mixed models on 1,315 random rushes (own-normalised lean -> pressure +3.6 points/sd; Hoop G -> lean; corner turn x Hoop G; tightness-matched turn x Hoop G; cluster-robust check); quantitative day-3 evaluation on all 47 held-out day-3 rushers (pooled rank correlation, AUC, top-third hit rate, 95% bootstrap gaps vs pick order and vs pick + role); wave-lean joint-model R2 gain interval; snap load + club pressure-rate controls; price check (clubs do not draft for Hoop G: 2% earlier per sd [-13, 15]). Football: lede and 'why lean produces pressure' paragraph in scout language; Table 2 is now the 7 names the flag adds beyond pick order with pick, Hoop G, result and a rule-based tape cue; stand-up vs hand-in-dirt stated as not separable (0.09% OLB snaps); 2026 names stated as impossible here (no 2026 Combine tracking in the release). Writeup: title says 'film flag, not a board input'; plain-sentence lede; each CI/n stated once in Table 1; four bullets under Table 1 cut to two sentences; interaction p, 88%, 70% and rookie-year moved to Table A1; 'Drill to Sunday' rewritten without the 0.36/0.14/0.05 chain. Viz: Fig 1 rebuilt as four-man drill-lap / NFL-rush small multiples on one yard and lean scale with a numeric strip and a takeaway title; new Fig 2 effect scatter (77 dots, flagged ringed, named, 95% band); Fig 3 slimmed to 8 rows, all 95%, colour legend; Fig 4 film queue at 95% with tally bar, wider sparklines, labelled 2026 mini-panel, shorter canvas; A1 and A2 merged (screen at 95% + slope placebo + nested-selection placebo).
open_risks: Accuracy gain does not survive honest selection: nested best-of-six R2 gain +0.06 has a 95% bootstrap interval [-0.27, 0.17] (positive in 45% of draws); only the slope is dependable
Nested procedure picked Hoop G in only 1 of 3 folds (other hoop measures in the rest), so the 'Hoop G specifically' claim rests on the slope and the wave-lean model
2025 alone is flat (+0.6 [-1.5, 2.6]); only the 2026 class is a clean test (59% power for one class)
Corner turn x Hoop G rush-level lead is p 0.03 with a random intercept but p 0.11 with player-clustered errors; exploratory
Hoop G does not predict how hard a man leans on Sunday (0.05 sd per sd), so the mechanism stays unexplained; most of Table 2's added names rarely bent on their sampled rushes
Stand-up vs hand-in-dirt alignment cannot be controlled (OLB tag on 0.09% of snaps); team scheme proxied only by club pressure rate of other cohort linemen
2026 day-3 names cannot be precomputed: no 2026 Combine tracking in this data release
